messages.subject_clean: Scale Arabia Product Sourcing & Price List Request
messages.body_plain:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I hope you are well.

We are Scale Arabia and are currently sourcing products and potential suppliers for our business. Could you please provide your latest product catalog and price list, along with any relevant product specifications and terms?

We would also appreciate it if you could confirm that we are communicating with the appropriate sales/product sourcing department or kindly direct us to the relevant contact.

We look forward to hearing from you and exploring a potential business relationship.

Thanks & Best Regards
